content.title: 2026 ACC tournament: Bracket, schedule, scores for men's basketball
content.text: The Duke Blue Devils have won the 2026 ACC men's basketball tournament. The tournament started Tuesday, March 10, and wrapped up on Saturday, March 14. All games were at the Spectrum Center in Charlotte, N.C. Check out the bracket, schedule and score information below. Duke won the 2025 conference crown, beating Louisville in the final. 2026 ACC tournament bracket Click or tap here for the tournament bracket. 2026 ACC tournament schedule, scores All times ET Tuesday, March 10 — First Round Game 1: No. 15 Pitt 64, No. 10 Stanford 63 Game 2: No. 11 SMU 86, No. 14 Syracuse 69 Game 3: No. 13 Wake Forest 95, No. 12 Virginia Tech 89 Wednesday, March 11 — Second Round Game 4: No. 7 NC State 98, No. 15 Pitt 88 Game 5: No. 6 Louisville 62, No. 11 SMU 58 Game 6: No. 8 Florida State 95, No. 9 Cal 89 Game 7: No. 5 Clemson 71, No. 13 Wake Forest 62 Thursday, March 12 — Quarterfinals Game 8: No. 2 Virginia 81, No. 7 NC State 74 Game 9: No. 3 Miami (Fla.) 78, No. 6 Louisville 73 Game 10: No. 1 Duke 80, No. 8 Florida State 79 Game 11: No. 5 Clemson 80, No. 4 North Carolina 79 Friday, March 13 — Semifinals Game 12: No. 2 Virginia 84, No. 3 Miami (Fla.) 62 Game 13: No. 1 Duke 73, No. 5 Clemson 61 Saturday, March 14 — Championship Game 14: No. 1 Duke 74, No. 2 Virginia 70 2026 ACC tournament seeds Duke Virginia Miami (Fla.) North Carolina Clemson Louisville NC State Florida State Cal Stanford SMU Virginia Tech Wake Forest Syracuse Pitt ACC tournament championship history Duke (23 times) has won the conference tournament the most often, including the 2025 triumph. North Carolina is next with 18 conference crowns.
